mainEntity.name: What makes Revolution Trading Pros different?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our proposed approach puts education, pre-trade planning, defined risk, and accessible service options ahead of exaggerated promises. We intend to publish timestamped documentation behind founder-reported historical trading claims. Marketing statements are not a substitute for verified records or a guarantee of results.

mainEntity.name: I have a $500 account. Is there a membership for me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the planned Small Accounts Room mentorship is intended for people who want to learn how limited capital affects position sizing, stock and options exposure, and account rules. A $500 account can be lost, and small balances limit what strategies are practical or appropriate.

mainEntity.name: Which option works with a full-time 9-to-5 job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with the Swing Trading Room or our Alert Services (SPX Profit Pulse and Explosive Swings). Both are designed around prepared market scenarios, entries, targets, and invalidation levels so you can review ideas outside a live trading room.

mainEntity.name: What comes with the video watchlist & alert memberships?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planned deliverables include detailed video setup explanations, relevant charts and catalysts, proposed entry zones, profit targets, risk levels, and alerts as scenarios develop across SPX Profit Pulse and Explosive Swings. Delivery terms and timing should be confirmed on the live membership page.

mainEntity.name: How do I apply for 1-on-1 mentorship?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit an application describing your experience, needs, goals, and schedule. The team reviews applications for fit. The program is not sold by immediate checkout, and acceptance or financial success is never guaranteed.

mainEntity.name: Who mentored the founder of Revolution Trading Pros, and why does it matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our founder was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who explicitly called him "the future of trading." It matters because most retail trading educators only teach recycled chart patterns. Learning directly from a Goldman Sachs proprietary trading veteran means our rooms, indicators, and courses are grounded in institutional order flow, liquidity mechanics, and asymmetric risk control.

mainEntity.name: How did you make 600% overnight on OXY Put Options when Warren Buffett went long?

acceptedAnswer.text: When news broke that Warren Buffett had purchased millions of dollars of Occidental Petroleum (OXY) shares, retail traders chased the headline at the top of an exhausted move. Using our institutional volume and liquidity exhaustion rules, we identified distribution into that retail buying wave, entered defined-risk OXY Put Options live, and locked in a 600% overnight gain—demonstrating why price and liquidity structure come before media headlines.

mainEntity.name: Why do you offer a Small Accounts Room for $500+ accounts and affordable alert services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because our founder stood on the losing end in the past and built Revolution Trading Pros around people, not making money. A trader starting with $500 or a working professional following our video watchlists (Explosive Swings or SPX Profit Pulse) deserves the same institutional discipline and risk transparency as a full-time day trader.

mainEntity.name: Why is your 1-on-1 Mentorship by application and approval only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Predatory marketers will charge exorbitant high-ticket fees to anyone with a credit card because they only care about subscription revenue. We refuse to operate that way. Our 1-on-1 Mentorship requires a formal application and manual approval so we only work with traders who are coachable, disciplined, and committed to the process.

mainEntity.name: Why do you emphasize "People Over Making Money" so strongly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because our founder has stood on the losing end in the past and knows firsthand how destructive fake gurus are to hardworking families. After being mentored by former Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick—and proving our edge live on the 2020 COVID top and bottom, the 2022 top and bottom, and our 600% overnight OXY Put Options trade—we didn't need to exploit retail traders for high-ticket course fees. We keep our services affordable so our members can actually prosper.

mainEntity.name: What if I only have $500 to start trading—am I really covered?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our Small Accounts Room was created specifically so traders starting with as little as $500 never have to gamble or copy trades meant for six-figure portfolios. We teach strict risk-per-trade limits, affordable contract selection, and cash-account settlement discipline so you can grow safely.

mainEntity.name: How do your alert-only memberships work if I can't join a live trading room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Through our accessible alert services—Explosive Swings and SPX Profit Pulse—we send you detailed video watchlists and trade alerts that map out the exact thesis, targeted entry price, tiered profit targets, and hard stop-loss level before the trade plays out.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I pay directly for 1-on-1 Mentorship on your website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because 1-on-1 Mentorship is strictly by application and approval only. If our goal were making quick money, we would put a checkout button on that page and take anyone's credit card. Instead, we review every applicant personally to ensure we only accept disciplined, coachable traders who are ready to commit to the process.

@graph.description: Strictly application-and-approval-only 1-on-1 mentorship built on the Goldman Sachs proprietary trading lineage of Mark 'Goldfinger' McGoldrick.

mainEntity.name: Why can't I just pay and join 1-on-1 Mentorship immediately?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because we focus on people over making money. Taking a credit card from someone who isn't ready to be coached is how predatory internet gurus operate. Because our founder was mentored 1-on-1 by former Goldman Sachs legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, we treat 1-on-1 mentorship as a serious partnership. We manually vet every applicant to guarantee a 100% fit before we ever discuss enrollment.

mainEntity.name: I am a struggling trader who has lost money to fake gurus—will my application be rejected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never for past losses—only for a bad attitude. Our founder stood on the losing end in the past too, which is why we created Track 03 (Struggling Trader Turnaround). We do not judge you by your past drawdowns or account size; we judge you strictly by your honesty, work ethic, and willingness to unlearn bad retail habits and follow mechanical entry, exit, and stop-loss rules.

mainEntity.name: How do you structure 1-on-1 Mentorship for Portfolio Managers and Institutional Traders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under Track 01, we work directly with Portfolio Managers, family offices, and proprietary traders on macro cycle regime detection (the exact framework behind our 2020 and 2022 top/bottom calls), liquidity-sweep execution, and asymmetric options hedging structures (such as the institutional distribution read behind our +600% overnight OXY Put Options trade).

mainEntity.name: When exactly do I receive the Sunday Alpha Protocol every week?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Sunday Alpha Protocol is dispatched every Sunday at 5:00 PM EST directly to your email inbox and private member dashboard—one full hour before Sunday night futures open. This gives you a quiet, distraction-free window to review all 5 to 7 blueprints and set your brokerage alerts before Monday morning.

mainEntity.name: What markets and asset classes do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: We focus strictly on high-liquidity U.S. large-cap equities (such as TSLA, NVDA, AMD, AAPL, MSFT, META) and major index ETFs (SPY, QQQ) where options bid-ask spreads are tight and institutional dark-pool volume is transparent. We never trade illiquid penny stocks, micro-caps, or futures.

mainEntity.name: How does the 1:2.50 minimum Risk-to-Reward math work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every setup is engineered so that the weighted blended return across Target 1 (50% scale at 1.6R), Target 2 (30% scale at 2.8R), and Target 3 (20% runner at 4.3R) equals or exceeds a 1:2.50 Risk-to-Reward multiplier. If a setup cannot mathematically clear 1:2.50 against structural invalidation, it is discarded.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to sit in front of screens during market hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Entries require a 15-minute candle close confirmation and swing holds span 2 to 5 trading sessions. You simply set price alerts on your brokerage platform on Sunday evening and execute when triggers confirm.

mainEntity.name: What is your cancellation policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can cancel your subscription at any time with a single click inside your self-service Stripe billing portal with zero recurring obligations. If you lock in the $47/month Founding Member rate, that price is grandfathered for the life of your active membership.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to watch the market all day to follow SPX Profit Pulse alerts?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. SPX Profit Pulse is specifically designed for traders who want institutional S&P 500 options execution without sitting in a 6-hour chatroom. Because we publish detailed video watchlists mapping our exact trigger levels ahead of time—and dispatch real-time API alerts the moment a trade opens, scales out, or adjusts its stop—both full-time traders and 9-to-5 working professionals can follow seamlessly.

mainEntity.name: Do you only trade 0DTE (Zero Days to Expiration), or do you also alert multi-day SPX setups?

acceptedAnswer.text: We trade both. When intraday volatility and dealer Gamma walls align, we execute high-asymmetry 0DTE and 1DTE setups. When macro structure favors multi-day expansion or high-probability Theta collection, we structure 2-to-14 DTE directional plays and defined-risk vertical spreads.

mainEntity.name: Can I follow SPX Profit Pulse if I have a small account ($500 to $2,500)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. While a single full-sized SPX option contract can be expensive, every SPX Profit Pulse alert can be executed in a smaller account using three methods we teach in the Learning Center: (1) Defined-risk 5-wide SPX vertical spreads, (2) XSP (Mini-SPX index options at 1/10th the notional size with the same cash settlement and Section 1256 tax perks), or (3) SPY ETF options.

mainEntity.name: How is SPX Profit Pulse different from the Live Day Trading Room or Explosive Swings?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPX Profit Pulse is a dedicated, alerts-and-video-watchlist service focused 100% on S&P 500 index options (SPX/XSP/SPY). Our Day Trading Room (/live-trading-rooms/day-trading-room) is a full live-voice and screen-share floor covering individual stocks, ETFs, and options. Explosive Swings (/alert-services/explosive-swings) is our multi-day stock and options swing alert service.

mainEntity.name: Do you trade micro-float penny stocks or liquid institutional stocks and options?

acceptedAnswer.text: We strictly trade high-liquidity US stocks, ETFs, and options. We never touch illiquid micro-float penny stocks. In penny-stock chatrooms, the host buys shares early and alerts 5,000 members who drive the price up for 10 seconds before getting dumped on. By trading deeply liquid institutional equities, ETFs, and options contracts, every member in our room can enter and exit cleanly without slippage traps.

mainEntity.name: Will I actually see your screen and hear your voice live, or is it just text alerts?

acceptedAnswer.text: You get live voice commentary and real-time screen sharing every market morning, paired with written level posts. Text-only rooms only tell you what someone bought after the fact. Watching our charts live and hearing our institutional thesis before the trigger price is hit teaches you why the trade works so you become a self-sufficient trader.

mainEntity.name: How does your Goldman Sachs mentorship lineage change how you day trade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our founder was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called him "the future of trading." Instead of chasing retail breakout candles, we track institutional order flow, liquidity sweeps, and buyer/seller exhaustion—the exact methodology behind our 2020 COVID top and bottom calls, our 2022 bull top and bear bottom calls, and our live 600% overnight gain on OXY Put Options opposite Warren Buffett.

mainEntity.name: What if I only want SPX index options alerts or pre-planned video watchlists?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you prefer dedicated alert-only services without sitting in the full day trading room, explore SPX Profit Pulse (/alert-services/spx-profit-pulse) for high-precision S&P 500 index options execution or Explosive Swings (/alert-services/explosive-swings), our accessible video watchlist alert membership delivering exact targeted entries, profit exits, and stop-loss levels.

mainEntity.name: Can I also use your custom non-repainting indicators and scanners alongside the room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The exact 100% non-repainting indicators and institutional order-flow scanners you see on our shared screens every morning are available in our Store (/store/indicators, /store/scanners, and /store/courses), alongside our free Options Calculator (/resources/options-calculator).

mainEntity.name: How much time per day do I need to follow the Swing Trading Room if I have a full-time job?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most working professionals in our room spend 15 to 20 minutes in the evening or before work. Because our swing setups focus on multi-day and multi-week institutional moves, we map out exact entry trigger prices, profit targets, and hard stop-losses ahead of time so you can set conditional orders with your broker without watching intraday ticks.

mainEntity.name: Do you swing trade shares of stock, ETFs, or options contracts?

acceptedAnswer.text: We cover all three: liquid US stocks, sector and index ETFs (See our ETF Stocks List (/resources/etf-stocks-list) and Stock Indexes List (/resources/stock-indexes-list)), and options contracts. Every setup specifies both the underlying stock/ETF price levels and the exact options structure (calls, puts, or defined-risk vertical/diagonal spreads) so you can trade shares, options, or both.

mainEntity.name: How is the Swing Trading Room different from your Explosive Swings alert service?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Swing Trading Room gives you full interactive room access—including live and recorded chart review sessions, portfolio hedging and sector rotation education, and direct Q&A where we review tickers you ask about. Explosive Swings (/alert-services/explosive-swings) is our affordable alert-only tier designed for independent traders who simply want our video watchlists and trade alerts with exact entries, exits, and stops sent to them.

mainEntity.name: How did your methodology call the 2020 and 2022 tops/bottoms and the +600% OXY trade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our founder was mentored directly by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick, who called him "the future of trading." By tracking institutional liquidity exhaustion, volume anomalies, and smart-money distribution rather than lagging retail indicators, we called the 2020 COVID top and bottom, the 2022 bull top and bear bottom, and shorted Occidental Petroleum (OXY) live with Put Options for a 600% overnight gain while Warren Buffett bought millions long.

mainEntity.name: Can I pair the Swing Trading Room with your custom non-repainting indicators and courses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All of the 100% non-repainting indicators and institutional scanners we use to spot multi-day accumulation and distribution are available in our Store (/store/indicators, /store/scanners, and /store/courses). If you want private, personalized coaching, you can also apply for our application-only 1-on-1 Mentorship (/mentorship).

audience.audienceType: Traders Starting With Small Accounts ($500 to $5,000+)

@graph.description: Dedicated live trading room and compounding framework engineered specifically for accounts starting as low as $500—covering affordable options contracts, T+1 cash account rotation, PDT navigation, and strict stop-loss discipline.

mainEntity.name: Is $500 really enough starting capital to join the Small Accounts Room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We specifically built the Small Accounts Room so traders starting with as little as $500 have an honest, institutional home. Instead of calling expensive contracts that require a $25,000 account, we focus on liquid, affordable stock, ETF, and options structures (including defined-risk vertical spreads) where your risk per trade is strictly capped.

mainEntity.name: Should I use a Cash Account or a Margin Account if I have less than $25,000?

acceptedAnswer.text: We teach you how to navigate both. In the United States, a Cash Account is exempt from the Pattern Day Trader (PDT) 3-day-trade limit—and because options and equities settle overnight on a T+1 schedule, your settled cash refreshes every single market morning. If you prefer a small margin account (or trade from Canada where PDT rules differ), we also execute multi-day swing setups and defined-risk spreads.

mainEntity.name: Why do you care about $500 small accounts when you have Goldman Sachs mentorship pedigree?

acceptedAnswer.text: Because our founder stood on the losing end in the past before being mentored by former Wall Street Goldman Sachs proprietary trading legend Mark "Goldfinger" McGoldrick (who called him "the future of trading"). After calling the 2020 COVID top and bottom, the 2022 market top and bottom, and banking 600% overnight on OXY Put Options live opposite Warren Buffett, our founder built Revolution Trading Pros to put people over making money—protecting everyday traders from the fake gurus who prey on small accounts.

mainEntity.name: What if I work a full-time job and also have a small $500+ account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every setup in the Small Accounts Room includes pre-planned entry triggers, profit targets, and hard invalidation stops—and all live sessions are recorded for on-demand replay. You can also pair your learning with our affordable Explosive Swings (/alert-services/explosive-swings) video watchlist alerts or our self-paced Trading Courses (/store/courses).

mainEntity.name: What happens once my small account grows past $10,000 or $25,000?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our entire goal is to graduate you. As your account compounds through our 4-Stage Roadmap, you seamlessly transition into our Day Trading Room (/live-trading-rooms/day-trading-room), Swing Trading Room (/live-trading-rooms/swing-trading-room), or apply for our application-only 1-on-1 Mentorship (/mentorship).

mainEntity.name: Which ETFs are best for trading options in a $500+ small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: For accounts starting between $500 and $2,500, we focus on ETFs that combine penny-wide bid-ask spreads with affordable contract prices: IWM (Russell 2000), XLF (Financials), XLE (Energy), GLD (Gold), and EEM (Emerging Markets)—as well as defined-risk vertical spreads on SPY and QQQ.

mainEntity.name: Why do institutional traders and working professionals prefer Sector ETFs over single stocks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Single stocks carry overnight idiosyncratic risk (such as an unexpected FDA rejection, SEC probe, or earnings gap). Sector ETFs like XLK, XLE, XLF, and SMH allow 9-to-5 working professionals to trade the dominant institutional money flow with smooth technical structure and zero single-company blowup risk.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between SPY and SPX when trading S&P 500 options?

acceptedAnswer.text: SPY is an Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) priced at roughly 1/10th the S&P 500 Index with American-style share settlement and dividend payments. SPX is the cash-settled S&P 500 Index itself (10x the notional size of SPY) with European-style exercise and US Section 1256 60/40 tax treatment. We trade SPY in our Day, Swing, and Small Accounts rooms and SPX inside SPX Profit Pulse.

mainEntity.name: How many official sectors are in the S&P 500, and which ETFs track them?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are 11 official GICS (Global Industry Classification Standard) sectors in the S&P 500, tracked by the 11 Select Sector SPDR ETFs: XLK (Technology), XLV (Healthcare), XLF (Financials), XLY (Consumer Discretionary), XLC (Communication Services), XLI (Industrials), XLP (Consumer Staples), XLE (Energy), XLU (Utilities), XLRE (Real Estate), and XLB (Materials).

mainEntity.name: What are the three major stock indexes?

acceptedAnswer.text:
1. S&P 500: measures 500 large-caps in U.S. stock market
2. Dow Jones 30: measures the top 30 U.S. large-cap stocks
3. Nasdaq 100: measures the top 100 largest non-financial companies

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a stock and an index?

acceptedAnswer.text: A stock allows investors partial ownership in a company. An index gives investors the option of investing in a basket of companies through products like ETFs, mutual funds, and derivatives.

mainEntity.name: Can you invest directly in an index?

acceptedAnswer.text: An index cannot be traded or invested in directly. Many different products, such as ETFs, mutual funds, and derivatives, are available to investors to gain exposure to index performance.

mainEntity.name: What are the ticker symbols for major indexes?

acceptedAnswer.text:
1. S&P 500 – SPX or $SPX
2. Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) – $DJI
3. Nasdaq Composite – COMPQ or $COMPQ
4. NYSE Composite – (DJ)
5. Russell 2000 – RUT or $RUT

mainEntity.name: What is the most widely cited US stock market index?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most widely cited US stock market index is the S&P 500, which measures 500 large-cap stocks and is considered the best representation of the overall U.S. stock market.

mainEntity.name: I am a complete beginner or starting with a $500 account—which course should I take first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with Course 02 (The $500+ Small Account Compounding & T+1 Cash Rotation Blueprint) paired with Course 08 (Ironclad Risk Architecture). They give you the exact mathematical position-sizing rules, cash-account settlement rotation, and pre-trade checklists we execute daily inside our Small Accounts Room.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to buy your custom indicators or scanners to use what is taught in the courses?

acceptedAnswer.text: No—raw price, volume, and Options Greeks come first. Every course teaches you how to read institutional market structure on any standard charting platform. Our 100% non-repainting Custom Indicators and Institutional Scanners are optional accelerators designed to spot those exact setups faster across multiple timeframes.

mainEntity.name: Do your indicators ever repaint or change past signals after the bar closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator in our Store is 100% non-repainting. Once a candle closes and a signal, squeeze dot, abandoned bar, or gamma level prints on your chart, it stays there permanently. We built Revolution Trading Pros to destroy the fake "holy grail" indicator scam, not participate in it.

mainEntity.name: Which trading platforms and markets do these indicators work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our custom indicators are built for ThinkorSwim (thinkScript) and TradingView. They work across all liquid US stocks, sector and index ETFs (see our free ETF Stocks List and Stock Indexes List), SPX/NDX index charts, and options contracts on intraday, daily, and weekly timeframes.

mainEntity.name: Are these indicators suitable for $500+ small accounts or working professionals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because our indicators plot objective entry triggers and tight structural stop-loss invalidation levels, they are ideal both for Small Accounts Room ($500+) traders who need strict risk caps and for 9-to-5 working professionals in our Swing Trading Room and Explosive Swings alert tier.

mainEntity.name: How do your indicators pair with your Scanners and Trading Courses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our Institutional Scanners automatically scan the entire market in real time to find tickers triggering our indicator conditions (such as Multi-Timeframe Squeezes or Liquidity Sweeps), while our Trading Courses teach you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution rules behind every setup.

mainEntity.name: How do these scanners install on ThinkorSwim and TradingView?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every scanner includes one-click import links and custom thinkScript code for ThinkorSwim (working inside both Stock Hacker, Option Hacker, and dynamic MarketWatch watchlist columns) as well as TradingView alert and screener templates—plus a step-by-step installation walkthrough video.

mainEntity.name: Do your scanners ever repaint or lag behind live market price action?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. All 8 scanners run on real-time market data using 100% non-repainting institutional math. Even better, because our scanners look for pre-ignition volatility compression and liquidity absorption, they alert you before the breakout candle fires rather than chasing extended moves.

mainEntity.name: Which scanner is best if I have a $500+ small account or work a full-time 9-to-5 job?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are building a small account starting around $500, use Scanner 04 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Options & Spread Scanner), which filters strictly for liquid options contracts and vertical spreads that fit a small risk budget. If you work a 9-to-5 career, use Scanner 05 (Working Professional 20-Minute End-of-Day Swing Scanner) to plan conditional multi-day orders in the evening.

mainEntity.name: Can I watch your team use these scanners live during market hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We run these exact scanners live on our shared screens every market morning inside our Day Trading Room, Swing Trading Room, and Small Accounts Room, and use them to curate the setups in SPX Profit Pulse and Explosive Swings.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Package 1 (Indicator Suite) and Package 2 (Indicators + Accelerator Class)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Package 1 gives you the complete 4-tool non-repainting indicator suite (Move Prior to The Move™ Ultra, Multi-Timeframe Matrix, On-Chart Stats Engine, and Bonus MP_EarlyInNOut™ Pro) plus our step-by-step installation session for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. Package 2 includes the entire indicator suite PLUS the 6-Module Accelerator Class where Billy Ribeiro teaches you the complete Goldman Sachs-mentored execution playbook, Options Greeks structuring, and bar-by-bar case studies.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the indicators in this package repaint after the candle closes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every indicator engineered by Revolution Trading Pros is 100% non-repainting. Once a price bar closes, every compression dot, liquidity sweep marker, early in/out trigger, and historical stat is permanently locked on your chart.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms, tickers, and timeframes do these tools and strategies work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: All indicators and workspace templates are built for ThinkorSwim and TradingView. They work on any liquid instrument—including US stocks, ETFs, SPX/NDX indexes, and futures—across all timeframes from 1-minute scalping charts to Daily and Weekly swing charts.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this course and indicator suite if I work a 9-to-5 job or have a $500 small account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Module 04 of the Accelerator Class is dedicated specifically to 9-to-5 working professionals (using a 20-minute evening routine and conditional orders) and $500+ small accounts (using T+1 cash account rotation and affordable, defined-risk options structures).

mainEntity.name: Is the Accelerator Class live or recorded, and how long do I keep access?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive immediate, lifetime on-demand access to all HD training modules, downloadable PDF playbooks, and workspace files so you can study and review them at your own pace 24/7.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: Are there step-by-step instructions for installing the indicators on desktop and mobile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You get instant access to our Quick-Start Indicator Installation Video and written setup guide the moment you enroll—covering ThinkorSwim Desktop, the ThinkorSwim Mobile App, and TradingView. If you ever want a hand, our support desk is available by phone or email.

mainEntity.name: What charting platforms and devices work with these indicators?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complete indicator suite is available for ThinkorSwim and TradingView on Windows, Mac, and Web—and the core Move Prior to The Move™ indicator is also fully compatible with the ThinkorSwim Mobile App (iOS and Android) so working professionals can monitor setups from anywhere.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the Buy/Sell or Early In/Out signals repaint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Unlike predatory "holy grail" scripts that erase losing signals in hindsight, 100% of our code is non-repainting. Once a candle closes, the compression level, Early In/Out marker, and Buy/Sell trigger remain on your chart permanently.

mainEntity.name: Where do I get access, and how long will I have access to the indicators and training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediately upon enrollment, all indicator scripts, workspace templates, the Strategy Class, the Precision Entries bonus session, and the 5 recorded live-trading days are unlocked in your member dashboard with lifetime on-demand access.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. mainEntity.name: Which platforms and devices work with the High Octane Scanner™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The High Octane Scanner™ works seamlessly with ThinkorSwim (Desktop and ThinkorSwim Mobile App via shared scan queries and dynamic watchlist alerts) and TradingView, plus instant SMS and email notifications.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the High Octane Scanner triggers repaint or use delayed data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every scan condition is 100% non-repainting and processes real-time market data. Once a compression, liquidity sweep, or Relative Volume anomaly triggers at bar close, it is permanent.

mainEntity.name: How does the High Octane Scanner help if I only have $500 to $2,500 in my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built Mode 03 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Contract Filter) specifically so small accounts never get priced out. It automatically filters for deeply liquid stocks and ETFs whose options contracts and vertical spreads fit safely within a $500+ risk rule.

mainEntity.name: Is installation difficult if I am not a programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coding is required. You receive one-click import links for ThinkorSwim and TradingView plus a step-by-step Quick-Start installation video. Most members have all scan presets and watchlist columns running in under 5 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. Annual access is designed for committed traders who want uninterrupted year-round access across all four quarterly earnings cycles.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and devices work with the High Octane Scanner™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The High Octane Scanner™ works seamlessly with ThinkorSwim (Desktop and ThinkorSwim Mobile App via shared scan queries and dynamic watchlist alerts) and TradingView, plus instant SMS and email notifications.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the High Octane Scanner triggers repaint or use delayed data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every scan condition is 100% non-repainting and processes real-time market data. Once a compression, liquidity sweep, or Relative Volume anomaly triggers at bar close, it is permanent.

mainEntity.name: How does the High Octane Scanner help if I only have $500 to $2,500 in my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built Mode 03 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Contract Filter) specifically so small accounts never get priced out. It automatically filters for deeply liquid stocks and ETFs whose options contracts and vertical spreads fit safely within a $500+ risk rule.

mainEntity.name: Is installation difficult if I am not a programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coding is required. You receive one-click import links for ThinkorSwim and TradingView plus a step-by-step Quick-Start installation video. Most members have all scan presets and watchlist columns running in under 5 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. Annual access is designed for committed traders who want uninterrupted year-round access across all four quarterly earnings cycles.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and devices work with the High Octane Scanner™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The High Octane Scanner™ works seamlessly with ThinkorSwim (Desktop and ThinkorSwim Mobile App via shared scan queries and dynamic watchlist alerts) and TradingView, plus instant SMS and email notifications.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the High Octane Scanner triggers repaint or use delayed data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every scan condition is 100% non-repainting and processes real-time market data. Once a compression, liquidity sweep, or Relative Volume anomaly triggers at bar close, it is permanent.

mainEntity.name: How does the High Octane Scanner help if I only have $500 to $2,500 in my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built Mode 03 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Contract Filter) specifically so small accounts never get priced out. It automatically filters for deeply liquid stocks and ETFs whose options contracts and vertical spreads fit safely within a $500+ risk rule.

mainEntity.name: Is installation difficult if I am not a programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coding is required. You receive one-click import links for ThinkorSwim and TradingView plus a step-by-step Quick-Start installation video. Most members have all scan presets and watchlist columns running in under 5 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. Annual access is designed for committed traders who want uninterrupted year-round access across all four quarterly earnings cycles.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and devices work with the High Octane Scanner™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The High Octane Scanner™ works seamlessly with ThinkorSwim (Desktop and ThinkorSwim Mobile App via shared scan queries and dynamic watchlist alerts) and TradingView, plus instant SMS and email notifications.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the High Octane Scanner triggers repaint or use delayed data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every scan condition is 100% non-repainting and processes real-time market data. Once a compression, liquidity sweep, or Relative Volume anomaly triggers at bar close, it is permanent.

mainEntity.name: How does the High Octane Scanner help if I only have $500 to $2,500 in my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built Mode 03 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Contract Filter) specifically so small accounts never get priced out. It automatically filters for deeply liquid stocks and ETFs whose options contracts and vertical spreads fit safely within a $500+ risk rule.

mainEntity.name: Is installation difficult if I am not a programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coding is required. You receive one-click import links for ThinkorSwim and TradingView plus a step-by-step Quick-Start installation video. Most members have all scan presets and watchlist columns running in under 5 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. Annual access is designed for committed traders who want uninterrupted year-round access across all four quarterly earnings cycles.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and devices work with the High Octane Scanner™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The High Octane Scanner™ works seamlessly with ThinkorSwim (Desktop and ThinkorSwim Mobile App via shared scan queries and dynamic watchlist alerts) and TradingView, plus instant SMS and email notifications.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the High Octane Scanner triggers repaint or use delayed data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every scan condition is 100% non-repainting and processes real-time market data. Once a compression, liquidity sweep, or Relative Volume anomaly triggers at bar close, it is permanent.

mainEntity.name: How does the High Octane Scanner help if I only have $500 to $2,500 in my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built Mode 03 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Contract Filter) specifically so small accounts never get priced out. It automatically filters for deeply liquid stocks and ETFs whose options contracts and vertical spreads fit safely within a $500+ risk rule.

mainEntity.name: Is installation difficult if I am not a programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coding is required. You receive one-click import links for ThinkorSwim and TradingView plus a step-by-step Quick-Start installation video. Most members have all scan presets and watchlist columns running in under 5 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. Annual access is designed for committed traders who want uninterrupted year-round access across all four quarterly earnings cycles.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and devices work with the High Octane Scanner™?

acceptedAnswer.text: The High Octane Scanner™ works seamlessly with ThinkorSwim (Desktop and ThinkorSwim Mobile App via shared scan queries and dynamic watchlist alerts) and TradingView, plus instant SMS and email notifications.

mainEntity.name: Do any of the High Octane Scanner triggers repaint or use delayed data?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Every scan condition is 100% non-repainting and processes real-time market data. Once a compression, liquidity sweep, or Relative Volume anomaly triggers at bar close, it is permanent.

mainEntity.name: How does the High Octane Scanner help if I only have $500 to $2,500 in my account?

acceptedAnswer.text: We built Mode 03 ($500+ Small Account Affordable Contract Filter) specifically so small accounts never get priced out. It automatically filters for deeply liquid stocks and ETFs whose options contracts and vertical spreads fit safely within a $500+ risk rule.

mainEntity.name: Is installation difficult if I am not a programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No coding is required. You receive one-click import links for ThinkorSwim and TradingView plus a step-by-step Quick-Start installation video. Most members have all scan presets and watchlist columns running in under 5 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Monthly and Annual access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both Monthly and Annual access unlock the complete High Octane Scanner™ suite, all 50+ institutional filters, mobile/desktop alerts, and the 5 recorded live-scanning training sessions. Annual access is designed for committed traders who want uninterrupted year-round access across all four quarterly earnings cycles.
